headline: City 5-3 Sunderland: five from five, Brobbey hat-trick in a loss
whyCareReason: Matchweek 5 is closed. City beat Sunderland 5-3 and lead the Premier League on 15 points from five games. Arsenal have 12. Brighton have 10.
teaser: FINAL: Manchester City 5-3 Sunderland. ESPN UK: Fernandez 9', Cherki 29', Semenyo 43' and 57', Haaland 81'. Brobbey hat-trick.
story:
Why this one matters: Arsenal lost 3-0 at Brighton on Saturday. City still had a game in hand. Sunday at the Etihad finished 5-3. City are five from five. The table is closed for Matchweek 5.

ESPN UK and AFP: Enzo Fernandez 9', Rayan Cherki 29', Antoine Semenyo 43' and 57', Erling Haaland 81'. Brian Brobbey 12', 33', 59', a hat-trick in a loss. IOL: Haaland's finish was flagged offside then given by VAR.

ESPN UK table after Sunday: City 15 from five, Arsenal 12, Brighton 10, Brentford 9, Leeds 9, Liverpool 9. Do not invent a sixth City goal. The printed score is 5-3.
stakes: A three-point lead after five games. Arsenal have a first league defeat. Matchweek 5 is in the book.
rivalryAngle: A 5-0-0 champion-elect against a promoted side that still scored three times through Brobbey.
